name: Wolcott-Rallison症候群

summary.text: Wolcott-Rallison syndrome (WRS) is a very rare genetic disease, characterized by permanent neonatal diabetes mellitus (PNDM) with multiple epiphyseal dysplasia and other clinical manifestations, including recurrent episodes of acute liver failure.

symptoms.text: recurrent episodes of acute liver failure
